title: Signal-driven intake lane for private/VPC/on-prem deployment requests
creator: Asha Mehta
description: Create a signal-driven, repeatable intake lane that classifies and prioritizes private/VPC/on-prem deployment requests from customers. Scope focuses on networking constraints (proxies, firewalls, egress rules), upgrade windows, air-gapped environments, and operator readiness. The lane should combine automated preflight probes, a lightweight questionnaire, and a scoring rubric to map inbound requests to one of four execution lanes (Self-serve guidance, Assisted onboarding, Dedicated-engagement, Deferred due to constraints).
acceptance_criteria: A short intake form + automated probe runs for top 5 network failure modes (proxy, NAT, TLS interception, DNS, egress) and returns a structured readiness score
Scoring rubric produced and documented; requests are assigned to one of the four lanes with rationale visible in the ticket metadata
Runbook templates exist for Assisted onboarding and Dedicated engagement with checklist items and SLA targets
Pilot with 10 inbound customer requests executed and outcome metrics captured: time-to-triage, percent assigned to Assisted/Dedicated, false-positive rate of blocked classification < 10%
proposed_solution: Build a lightweight backend that ingests intake form responses and triage probes. The backend will compute a readiness score and return lane assignment. Surface the score and recommended remediation steps in the ticket, and attach a templated runbook to Assisted/Dedicated lanes. Integrate with the existing network-probe library (or ship a minimal probe bundle if library gaps exist). Provide a short public-facing self-serve doc and an internal playbook for Solutions Eng to execute Assisted onboardings.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): Design intake form + probe checklist; prototype scoring logic; stakeholder review
Phase 2 (3 weeks): Implement backend service, integrate probes, wire to Linear so new tickets are auto-scored and labeled
Phase 3 (4 weeks): Pilot with 10 customers flagged by CS; collect outcomes and iterate scoring thresholds
Phase 4 (ongoing): Promote live, add automation to route to Solutions Eng queues and report SLA metrics to Console
